headline: Gen Digital (GEN) Beats Q1 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Gen Digital (GEN) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +2.90% and +2.54%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
